main_measure.name: mean of (24-bar return minus coin mean 24-bar return) x forecast/10 on settlement-bar bets
main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 with supporting check passing on >= 100 cases; reject t <= -2 on >= 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 24-bar return, upper half minus lower half at the median forecast

decided_by: The main measure's t is 2 or more but the supporting check fails (upper half minus lower half not above 0).
reading: Settlement bars are those whose close (start + 1 hour) is at 00:00 or 16:00 UTC, a case is the first bet (forecast rise of at least 2) on a settlement bar in each 24-row grid cell of a window, the coin mean is over non-overlapping 24-bar returns at rows 0, 24, ... of all windows, and the upper half is forecasts strictly above the median, the lower half at or below it.
